metadata.description: Live-captured GET /api/mdm/smartgroups/{id} against UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-07-30 -- readback immediately after DeleteAsync, confirming the group is actually gone. Wire-vs-expectation note: the live API does NOT return HTTP 404 for a deleted/missing smart group; it returns HTTP 400 with errorCode 6 and a descriptive not-found message. Treat this 400/errorCode:6 shape as the real 'not found' signal for this endpoint, not a literal 404.

body.message: Smart Group not found with Id: 12345 or User does not have access to it.
